hub.name: Web design Abu Dhabi

hero.joke: When six people have to approve a website, the website should come with paperwork.
hero.intro: Web design for Abu Dhabi organisations, where a website is often signed off by several people and not one owner. Bilingual English and Arabic sites with clear structure, phased scopes and documentation at every step.

items.p: English and Arabic designed side by side, each in its own direction. Not one mirrored at the last minute.
Readable contrast, keyboard navigation, proper headings and alt text. Built in from the start, because adding it later costs more.
Divisions, services, leadership, news and careers arranged so a visitor can find the right department.
Reports, policies and forms organised, searchable and easy to replace when the new version arrives.
Scope, sitemap, design decisions and a handover manual. Written down, so the project survives a change of staff.
Each department edits its own pages and nothing else. Training included.

fit.p: This page is for projects with more than one decision-maker. We keep those moving with written scopes, clear milestones and one named contact on our side. There are no government logos on our wall yet, and we won't pretend otherwise.
yes: A company or institution that needs both languages
Required to document what was built and why
Sharing one website between several departments
fit.no: you're a small business that needs a good site quickly. [Web design Dubai](/services/web-design-dubai/) describes that service better. For internal systems, see [web application development](/services/web-application-development/).

items.p: A free call, then a written scope with phases, milestones and a fixed quote your finance team can read.
Sitemap and wireframes approved before design, so the argument about the menu happens once.
Both languages designed together, with review rounds booked in advance.
Launch, training for each department and the documentation pack. Free fixes for 30 days.

price.p: Our fixed plans run from $1,299 to $6,499, about AED 4,800 to 23,900. Larger bilingual sites with many departments are scoped and quoted in phases. Either way the price is fixed before work starts, and the [plans](/pricing/) are public.

faq.q: Can you work with our procurement process?
faq.a: Yes. We provide detailed scopes, phased milestones and the paperwork procurement and finance usually ask for. Tell us the process early and we'll fit the timeline around it.

faq.q: Do you build fully bilingual sites?
faq.a: Yes, English and Arabic with proper right-to-left layouts. We design both directions from the start. Our [Arabic and RTL guide](/blog/arabic-rtl-website-design/) explains the difference that makes.

faq.q: Can different departments manage their own pages?
faq.a: Yes. Roles and permissions are set so each team edits only its own sections, and each team gets its own training.
We build to the WCAG basics: contrast, keyboard use, semantic markup and alt text. A formal certificate needs a specialist auditor, and we'll tell you when you need one.
